name: openlmis-role-assignments-table
title: Role Assignments Table
description: One role type's assignments for a user: search, sort and paging in the browser, program and supervisory node or facility columns that fold under the role when narrow, Unsaved and Ignored badges, names that show a placeholder until they load, and View Rights and Remove row actions.
docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.
